        if [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] || [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if the value is empty or only whitespace
        if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then

        echo "  ✓ $key is set"

        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/"/\"/g')
        
        # Add key-value pair to JSON array
        JSON_ARRAY+=("\"${key}\":\"${value}\"")
    done < "$ENV_FILE"
